settings.main.profile_hint: How you appear to others on WhatsApp.
settings.main.whatsapp_hint: Account settings stored by WhatsApp, the same ones your phone shows.
settings.main.accounts_hint: Every account keeps its own session, history and settings.
settings.main.privacy_hint: The RAM window and disk archive have separate limits. Evicting a message from RAM leaves it available on disk. Disk limits below delete stored messages.
settings.main.spaces_hint: Local views on this device. Back up their definitions below.
settings.main.notifications_hint: Desktop notifications for new direct messages and group messages.
settings.main.companion_hint: View-once photos, videos and voice notes only reach this device through a second, Android-style link. It is not a second inbox: it wakes when a one-time message arrives, fetches it into this chat, then goes dormant. It never replaces your main link and never unlinks anything from your phone.
settings.main.plugins_hint: Installed plugins are native programs. Enable only plugins you trust. Restart Postal to discover newly installed plugins.
settings.main.keybinds_hint: Composer shortcuts. Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want.
settings.main.appearance_hint: Themes and CSS extensions apply instantly and are saved on this device.
settings.main.advanced_hint: Developer-oriented options. These only change logging.
settings.main.about_hint: A native WhatsApp client that speaks the protocol directly.
settings.main.name: Name
settings.main.username_hint: Usernames are managed on your phone.
settings.main.send_typing_hint: Others see "typing…" while you write. Off, you still see theirs. The default for every chat; the eye beside a chat's message box overrides it there.
settings.main.send_receipts_hint: Off, nobody learns you read a message, heard a voice note or opened view-once media, in groups too. Unlike WhatsApp's own read receipts setting below, you keep seeing other people's. The default for every chat; the eye beside a chat's message box overrides it there.
settings.main.remove_account_suffix: ? Its session and history on this computer are deleted; the phone keeps everything.
settings.main.ram_messages_hint: Messages kept in memory per conversation: {min}–{max}. Default: {count}. Older pages load from disk before asking your phone.
settings.main.keep_history_hint: Off keeps messages in memory only: they show while Postal runs and are gone when it quits. Applies the next time Postal starts; clear history below to remove what is already saved.
settings.main.history_folder_hint: Where the full message archive is kept. Empty uses the app data folder. Applies the next time Postal starts: the existing archive is moved there. Leave both disk limits below blank to keep everything.
settings.main.disk_duration_hint: Older messages are deleted after a live message batch, and the space is freed. New installations have no disk limit. Leave blank for no limit.
settings.main.disk_messages_hint: Only the newest are kept when a disk cap is set. Leave blank to keep the archive unlimited.
settings.main.request_full_history_hint: The next link requests up to {count} days of history; your phone may supply less. This can take time and disk space. Disk retention above still applies independently. Off accepts recent history only; older messages remain available on demand.
settings.main.download_history_hint: Asks your phone for every chat's older messages, page by page, for an account that is already linked. Keep the phone online; progress shows at the bottom. Disk retention still applies. Set both disk limits to unlimited to keep all fetched history.
settings.main.clear_message_history_hint: Deletes every message stored on this computer. Names and chat settings stay; the phone keeps everything.
settings.main.keep_archived_hint: On: a new message leaves the chat in the Archived list. Off: the chat moves back to your main list as soon as a message arrives.
settings.main.freeze_hover_hint: On: the chat list keeps its order while the pointer is over it, so a new message cannot move the chat under your cursor. Previews and unread counts still update; the new order applies when the pointer leaves or you open a chat. Off: the list reorders immediately.
settings.main.chat_preview_hint: On: hovering a chat shows its recent messages in a popup. Off: no popup.
settings.main.export_metadata_hint: Copy this device's local Space definitions and references as JSON. WhatsApp data stays unchanged.
settings.main.import_metadata_hint: Adds local Space definitions and references. WhatsApp data stays unchanged.
settings.main.enable_notifications_hint: Off silences every chat, immediately. Muted chats never notify, whether this is on or off; unmute one from its menu in the chat list.
settings.main.notifications_off: Notifications are off — new messages will not ping you.
settings.main.notifications_on: Notifications are on for every chat except muted ones.
settings.main.notifications_pending: Notifications are on here, but the system has not allowed them yet — see below.
settings.main.mute_all_hint: On: @all mentions stay silent everywhere; direct mentions still ping. Off: each chat decides for itself — chats muting @all are listed below.
settings.main.chats_muting_all_hint: Turn the mute off again for one chat.
settings.main.notifications_unsupported: This system does not support desktop notifications.
settings.main.notifications_allowed: Allowed. Notifications appear when a new message arrives in another chat.
settings.main.notifications_denied: Blocked. Postal cannot ask again from here: re-enable it in the system settings (GNOME Settings → Notifications → Postal; macOS System Settings → Notifications; Windows Settings → Notifications), then press Recheck.
settings.main.notifications_prompt: Not decided yet. Press Allow and the system asks once.
settings.main.notification_history_hint: Up to {count} recent events, stored locally for this account.
